g.text: Marts star schema: three facts, six conformed dimensions

text.tspan: Grain (unique tests): fact_vaccination = one dose to one synthetic person (person_id, vaccine_key);
fact_vaccine_receipt = one lot shipment to one unit (health_unit_key, lot_key);
fact_population = municipality x sex x age 0-6 x census year.
Also tested: dim_vaccine_lot.vaccine_code in dim_vaccine, dim_health_unit.municipality_code in dim_municipality.
Every dimension except dim_date has an Unknown row (key 00000000-...), so facts hold no null keys.
